explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1166 (Erdős–Révész): for the simple random walk on ℤ², is |⋃_{k≤n} F(k)| ≤ (log n)^{O(1)} a.s. for all large n? Yes: it is ≪ (log n)² via |F(n)| ≤ 3 eventually and Erdős–Taylor. The statement asserts a single exponent C such that a.s. the union's encard is eventually ≤ (log n)^C. That is the natural reading, and the true O((log n)²) bound gives it. Faithful.
